protocol: Same custom confidence-ordered IoU>=0.5 crop matching as source reports.
limitations: A missed GT includes insufficient localization/score, not just absent detection.
Unmatched predictions may be duplicates or unannotated plants, not confirmed nonplant diagnoses.
Generic leaf labels do not establish healthy states. No disease accuracy is measured.
Class-specific values with small GT denominators are descriptive, not stable field estimates.
